label: copy-phase input j in length-9 sequences (strongest on the last two steps)
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps). It fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original or delimiter steps, and almost only when L = 9 (96% of mass). The input token is usually the fed-back j (78% of mass, lift 25x); a few activations are on n, 2, or r. Magnitude is largest on the last two copy steps (recall_idx 7-8, about 70% of mass), with a smaller group at recall_idx 2-3. The predicate covers about 74% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 6%: most copy-phase j inputs in length-9 sequences do not fire, and adding position (recall_idx >= 7) or repeat-count conditions trades recall for little precision gain (F1 <= 0.18). So it is a j/late-copy/L=9 unit with an unexplained extra condition.
